title: Re: Alliant Systems — partner integration compatibility checklist & kickoff
text:
Re: Alliant Systems — partner integration compatibility checklist & kickoff

["From: Samir Kapoor <samir@bridgeway.consult>\\nTo: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>\\nCc: Alliant Systems Eng <eng@alliant.com>\\nDate: 2025-06-03T09:12:00-07:00\\nSubject: Solution compatibility checklist for Alliant Systems integration\\n\\nHi Laura,\\n\\nThanks for agreeing to help run the technical validation for Alliant Systems. Attached is the checklist Bridgeway put together after our initial scoping call — it lists the APIs, expected token sizes, and the minimal latency constraints Alliant expects from a hosted inference endpoint.\\n\\nQuick asks before we schedule kickoff:\\n- Can Redwood confirm whether prefix KV caching can be enabled for the private deployment option?\\n- Is there a recommended quantization profile for Alliant's LLMs (they plan to use a 4-bit variant)?\\n- Any known network egress constraints for a DGX-style private cluster?\\n\\nProposed kickoff window: Thursday 6/5 or Friday 6/6 10–12 PT.\\n\\nAttachment: bridgeway-compat-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)\\n\\nThanks,\\nSamir Kapoor\\nTechnical Lead — Bridgeway Consulting\\nsamir@bridgeway.consult\\n+1 (415) 555-0134\\n\\n", "From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>\\nTo: Samir Kapoor <samir@bridgeway.consult>\\nCc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2025-06-03T11:03:00-07:00\\nSubject: Re: Solution compatibility checklist for Alliant Systems integration\\n\\nSamir —\\n\\nAppreciate the checklist. I skimmed the sheet and flagged a couple of rows that look like potential blockers (large streaming payloads + low latency target).\\n\\nI think a 45-minute technical kickoff is the right first step. Proposed agenda (attached):\\n- 10m introductions & goals\\n- 10m Alliant architecture overview (Samir / Alliant)\\n- 15m Redwood runtime fit and config options (Karthik)\\n- 10m Next steps / test matrix & timelines\\n\\nCan you confirm if Thurs 6/5 10:30 PT works? If not, I can do Fri 6/6 10:00 PT.\\n\\nInitial answers inline:\\n- Prefix KV caching: supported for hosted + Dedicated; for Private we need to enable it in the runtime config — Karthik will include the ops checklist in the kickoff.\\n- 4-bit quantization: we have a recommended profile that usually preserves chat-quality for Alpaca-style models; we will surface model-specific guidance after we see Alliant's weights and perf traces.\\n- Network egress: Private on-prem clusters must allow outbound to our control-plane endpoints on 443; we can run a firewall-friendly mode but will need a small NAT flow for telemetry.\\n\\nI attached a short kickoff agenda PDF and added Karthik and Kimberly to help with validation planning.\\n\\nAttachment: proposed-kickoff-agenda.pdf (PDF)\\n\\nBest,\\nLaura Bennett\\nPrincipal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference\\nlaura_bennett@redwood.com\\n\\n", "From: Samir Kapoor <samir@bridgeway.consult>\\nTo: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>\\nCc: Alliant Systems Eng <eng@alliant.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2025-06-03T14:22:00-07:00\\nSubject: Re: Solution compatibility checklist for Alliant Systems integration\\n\\nLaura —\\n\\nThursday 6/5 10:30 PT works for Alliant. Attaching the latest architecture diagram and a small CSV with expected per-request token distributions.\\n\\nTwo clarifications from Alliant's engineering lead (looping him into this thread):\\n1) They plan to run both hosted (for rapid dev) and Private (for regulated production). For Private they'd prefer not to allow any outbound calls except to the control plane; you mention a NAT flow — can we get detailed firewall rules so their security team can pre-approve?\\n2) They will likely use the Llama2-derived model at a 4-bit quant; they asked whether Redwood has any known regressions in generation quality with that quant profile.\\n\\nAttachments: alliant-arch-v1.drawio.png (diagram), eligibility-matrix.csv (CSV)\\n\\n—Samir\\n\\nOn Thu, Jun 3, 2025 at 11:03 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com> wrote:\\n> Samir —\\n> \\n> Appreciate the checklist. I skimmed the sheet and flagged a couple of rows that look like potential blockers (large streaming payloads + low latency target).\\n> \\n> I think a 45-minute technical kickoff is the right first step. Proposed agenda (attached):\\n> - 10m introductions & goals\\n> - 10m Alliant architecture overview (Samir / Alliant)\\n> - 15m Redwood runtime fit and config options (Karthik)\\n> - 10m Next steps / test matrix & timelines\\n> \\n> Can you confirm if Thurs 6/5 10:30 PT works? If not, I can do Fri 6/6 10:00 PT.\\n> \\n> Initial answers inline: ...\\n\\n", 'From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>\\nTo: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Samir Kapoor <samir@bridgeway.consult>\\nCc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Alliant Systems Eng <eng@alliant.com>\\nDate: 2025-06-04T08:15:00-07:00\\nSubject: Re: Solution compatibility checklist for Alliant Systems integration\\n\\nThanks for the context — adding a few technical notes ahead of the kickoff so security and ops can review early: \\n\\nValidation matrix (high level):\\n- Connectivity: control-plane (443) outbound to api.redwood.com + registry endpoints. If egress is fully restricted, we can flip to an offline-key mode but that requires a brief manual bootstrap and rw token exchange.\\n- Runtime features: prefix KV caching can be toggled per-service; sustained throughput tests should include "warmup" to populate caches.\\n- Quantization: 4-bit supported; we recommend the q4_0 profile for Llama2 variants and running a small A/B eval on representative prompts — expect a 2–4% degradation vs fp16 on generation metrics in worst-case, but often imperceptible.\\n- Latency target: for streaming workloads with avg 120 tokens/request we should plan for Dedicated capacity during production; sandbox runs on a single A10-style host may not meet p95 targets.\\n\\nTest plan (short):\\n1) Sandbox deploy (private) with NVLink disabled to emulate customer on-prem resources — 2 days\\n2) Load-based metric sweep: tokens per second, p50/p95 latency, throughput; record KV cache hit rates — 2 days\\n3) Quality regression: run customers\' prompt set vs baseline fp16 — 1 day\\n4) Signoff and runbook handoff — 1 day\\n\\nI\'ll bring a sample runbook and the firewall IP ranges to kickoff. Kimberly, can you prepare the observability packet (dashboard + token-cost template)?\\n\\nKarthik Iyer\\nSenior Runtime Engineer — Redwood Inference\\nkarthik_iyer@redwood.com\\n\\n', "From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>\\nTo: Samir Kapoor <samir@bridgeway.consult>\\nCc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Alliant Systems Eng <eng@alliant.com>\\nDate: 2025-06-05T15:27:00-07:00\\nSubject: Re: Solution compatibility checklist for Alliant Systems integration — kickoff confirmed\\n\\nGreat — confirmed for Thu 6/5 10:30 PT. Agenda as attached; Karthik will present the validation matrix and firewall/IP ranges. Kimberly will bring the observability/cost slice and a sample dashboard.\\n\\nAction items after kickoff (owners):\\n- Bridgeway / Alliant: share final model weights and representative prompt corpus (Samir) — due 6/12\\n- Karthik: sandbox deploy + firewall ranges (Redwood) — due 6/13\\n- Kimberly: observability template + cost estimates (Redwood) — due 6/13\\n- Laura: draft mutual action plan and runbook shell, share Doc link — due 6/16\\n\\nI've added the HubSpot deal and a Confluence page for tracking. Please reply if owners or dates need adjustment.\\n\\nBest,\\nLaura Bennett\\nPrincipal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference\\nlaura_bennett@redwood.com\\n\\nOn Wed, Jun 4, 2025 at 8:15 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:\\n> Thanks for the context — adding a few technical notes ahead of the kickoff so security and ops can review early: ...\\n\\n"]
